name: WARNING: In-Flight Salted Roasted Peanuts Packet (Hard Particles & Strictures)
whyItWorks: Standard in-flight complimentary snack pack. Even with chewing, hard roasted peanut fragments resist stomach acid digestion, creating gritty friction against inflamed ileal or colonic walls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Politely pass on the peanut packet. Ask the flight attendant for Biscoff cookies or pretzels instead.
